ns2:course.label: Research Seminars
ns2:course.description: Discussions and lectures on current research under the direction of individual staff members. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. May be repeated. A maximum of 2 hours of MSE 529, MSE 559, and MSE 590 may count toward the MatSE M.S. degree; likewise 4 hours for the MatSE Ph.D. degree. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
